info.name: Pharmacy Management System API
info.description: Backend on port 2195 (change baseUrl if you use another port). Run "Auth → Login" first: the token is saved and sent automatically (Bearer). Create requests save their new id into collection variables so the following Get / Update / Delete work. Quantities in stock are base units (tablets / capsules / bottles). See API.md for every field.

request.description: Permission company-profile › edit. name, phone and address are required. logo = image data URL (any image type); null removes it; leave it out to keep the current logo. receipt_width 58 or 80 (mm), receipt_copies 1-3, receipt_show_logo / receipt_show_barcode true/false, receipt_header / receipt_thanks / receipt_policy optional text (empty = not printed), max_discount_pct 0-100 = highest discount % allowed at POS.

item.name: Save company profile — keep current logo
Import medicines (all rows valid or nothing is saved)

exec: if (j.success) { pm.collectionVariables.set('grnId', j.data.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('grnItemId', j.data.items[0].id); pm.collectionVariables.set('batchId', j.data.items[0].batch_id); }

item.name: Update GRN (use item ids from Get GRN)

request.description: Refused when discount_pct is higher than max_discount_pct in Pharmacy Settings.
Puts the order's stock back into the same batches, reverses credit, marks the invoice Cancelled (excluded from sales reports). A cancelled order cannot be reopened.

item.name: Document report (sale-invoices | sale-returns | purchases | grn | purchase-returns)

request.description: Permission database-backup › edit. every_days 1-365, run_time HH:MM (24h), keep_count 0 = keep all, folder = full path on the server PC (created if missing).
Permission database-backup › create. Full backup (schema + data) with pg_dump into the backup folder.
Returns the .sql file. Restore with: psql -U postgres -d <db> -f <file>

item.name: Cleanup (run last — some deletes are refused by design, e.g. a supplier with purchases)
Change password (sets it back after testing!)
